scripts.text: - You cannot proceed because you have too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 您攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續。-

scripts.text:
[Dimension Traveler]
Adventurer friend, {0} is what I need. How about exchanging it with something I have?

[次元旅行者]

scripts.text: Show me your weapon.

scripts.text:
[Dimension Traveler]

[Dimension Traveler]

[次元旅行者]

scripts.text:
[Dimension Traveler]
Huhh! It seems like many of them already heard that I have the best stuff. Feel free to check out my collections.
scripts.translation:
[次元旅行者]
嘿！看來很多人都聽說我這兒有最好的貨了。隨便看看我的收藏吧。

scripts.text:
[Dimension Traveler]
Goodbye friend~ Come again!
scripts.translation:
[次元旅行者]
再見，朋友~ 歡迎再來！

scripts.text: [Dimension Traveler]

[次元旅行者]

[Dimension Traveler]
